findings.title: The concurrent reader is neither synchronized nor joined before asserting
findings.body: The test starts the reader thread and immediately begins deletion, then asserts `caughtExceptions` without waiting for the reader to have made even one request or for its in-flight request to complete. Depending on scheduling, the reader can start only after all groups are deleted, or it can add the failure after the assertion has already passed, so this regression test can pass even with the NPE still present. Retain the thread (or use an executor), coordinate that a read is in progress before deletion, signal it in a finally block, and join it with a timeout before checking the captured exceptions.
